boot_blockers.rule: Kingsmen may not boot without backend-controlled state transitions.
n8n may not contain orchestration brain logic.
Kingsmen may not claim production truth without PostgreSQL truth vault.
Blocked portals must generate MAP manual fallback.
Kingsmen may not present route intelligence as verified without source confidence.
WhatsApp must remain urgent-only, not primary routine communication.
No module may be called complete without files, validator, report, and next action.
